subject: Improvements for TLS with I/O threads (#1271)
reason: The change is confined to src/tls.c: it fixes main-thread/I/O-thread races on SSL objects (caching SSL_pending() in a new TLS_CONN_FLAG_HAS_PENDING flag set at each SSL_read, narrowing ERR_clear_error() to just before each SSL call, and running updatePendingData on write events too). Every modified line executes only on TLS connections.
